title: Android 1.19.0 download with phone vibration on the map wheel
summary: The website's Android download is now version 1.19.0: the map's action wheel uses the phone's own vibration, plus the fixes made since 1.18.0.
items: Downloads offers Android 1.19.0 with its checksum; install it over the existing app. Saved campaigns, sign-in and placed widgets are kept.
Fixes since 1.18.0: Uses left typing, reopened shared rooms keeping your last action, and the DM's screen missing players' dice.
